title: Premium Charges, Surcharges and Payment Terms — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
The fixed premium charges and payment terms of the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) are the same on every tier.

| Tier | HFIAA surcharge (USD per term) | Reserve Fund Assessment (percent) | Annual risk premium increase cap (percent) | Probation surcharge (USD per term) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | 250 | 18 | 18 | 50 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | 250 | 18 | 18 | 50 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | 250 | 18 | 18 | 50 |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | 250 | 18 | 18 | 50 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | 250 | 18 | 18 | 50 |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | 250 | 18 | 18 | 50 |

| Tier | Full term premium with application or renewal | Underpayment cure period (calendar days) | Accepted payment methods |
|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | yes — no installments | 30 | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | yes — no installments | 30 | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | yes — no installments | 30 | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | yes — no installments | 30 | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | yes — no installments | 30 | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | yes — no installments | 30 | check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement |

## Meaning of each line

- **HFIAA surcharge — 250 per term.** The HFIAA annual surcharge for a policy that is not a primary residence, which is every policy on this form.
- **Reserve Fund Assessment — 18 percent.** Charged on the risk premium plus the ICC premium.
- **Annual increase cap — 18 percent.** The statutory cap on the year-over-year increase of the risk premium line at renewal.
- **Probation surcharge — 50 per term.** Added to each term while the community is on probation.
- **Full premium.** The full term premium must accompany the application or renewal; there are no installments.
- **Underpayment cure — 30 calendar days.** Days after Tidemark's underpayment notice to pay the difference before limits are reduced to what the premium received buys.
- **Payment methods.** Tidemark accepts NFIP premium by check, ACH, credit card or escrow disbursement.

**Hypothetical figure.** A risk premium of 2,000 and an ICC premium of 100 together come to 2,100; 18 percent of 2,100 is 378.

## Parameter meanings

- HFIAA annual surcharge for a policy that is not a primary residence, which is every policy on this form; USD per term.
- Reserve Fund Assessment charged on the risk premium plus ICC premium; percent.
- Statutory cap on the year-over-year increase of the risk premium line at renewal; percent.
- Surcharge added to each term while the community is on probation; USD per term.
- Whether the full term premium must accompany the application or renewal (no installments); boolean.
- Days after Tidemark's underpayment notice to pay the difference before limits are reduced to what the premium received buys; calendar days.
- Payment methods Tidemark accepts on NFIP premium; list of enum.
